audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart (Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed) contradicts both this packet (Garen for stages 1 through Level 6, Singed at first item and two-plus items) and the page's own whys[], which say Garen bullies level 1 and out-duels a level-6 Singed. But the already-audited mirror singed__garen corrected its chart to Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill/Skill/Skill, which disagrees with this packet at Level 6, first item and two-plus items. I did NOT propose chart edits here rather than introduce a mirror contradiction by guessing.
audit.why: Singed has no combat pattern before Fling, so the early Garen rows are not in doubt from either source. The disputed stages are Level 6 onward, where the two packets differ on whether the lane goes even or hands Singed the advantage. Both readings are defensible and I have no basis to pick.
audit.corrected: Deferred — see notes and the question raised for the user. No level-chart edits proposed for this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late and two-item spikes were built on Rylai's slow making Singed 'a wraith you can never catch' and 'impossible to pin'. That is false against Garen specifically, and the page never mentioned Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds, which is the actual thing that changes Garen's maths after 6.
audit.why: Decisive Strike 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him' on a flat 8-second cooldown at every rank. Mega Adhesive's slow and any Rylai's slow are purged on demand, so slow-based kiting is not what beats Garen here. What does hurt is Insanity Potion making Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts Perseverance — the sustain the whole early plan rests on. The mirror reached the same two conclusions independently.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds named as the real 6-plus spike; the Rylai's-uncatchable claim replaced with the slow-break fact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was listed at a 14-second cooldown; Riot's value is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, so 10s at rank 1. The decisive combo was never stated: Riot's Fling text reads 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' The page treated Fling as a pure reposition and Mega Adhesive as a separate slow, missing that they are one setup.
audit.why: Fling alone moves Garen 125 units and leaves him free to keep spinning. Fling into pre-laid Mega Adhesive roots him, and that is the version that gets him killed or delivered to a jungler. The counterplay is positional and concrete: do not stand near the goo, and the flip is survivable. Mega Adhesive's grounding is also irrelevant against Garen — he has no dash, and Decisive Strike is a move-speed burst rather than a dash, so grounding costs him nothing.
audit.corrected: Fling's real 10s rank-1 cooldown stated, and the Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root named as the thing to position against.

audit.whatIsWrong: All-in window keyed to a wrong 14s Fling cooldown.
audit.why: Fling at 10s rank 1 is a much tighter window than the page implied, so 'bait it then commit' needs the real number to be actionable.
audit.corrected: Re-stated at 10s with the positional condition attached.
